summary: Chamath argues NVIDIA and other AI stocks are at the tail end of the hype cycle, with every post-earnings spike being used by investors as a selling opportunity, evidenced by massive share turnover and prices moving straight down.
quote: NVIDIA's turned over 308 million shares today... It's going straight down like a lead balloon.

summary: Chamath notes Meta rallied on AI demand commentary but then gave up all gains, consistent with his view that investors are selling into every spike as the AI hype cycle peaks.
quote: Meta rallied. They've basically given up all of their gains. It's gone kind of straight down today.
